source.also: Silbering AF, Rytz R, Grosjean Y, Abuin L, Ramdya P, Jefferis GSXE, Benton R (2011) Complementary function and integrated wiring of the evolutionarily distinct Drosophila olfactory subsystems. J Neurosci 31:13357-13375

ir.rule: a glomerulus is IR-fed when a receptor in Task et al. 2022's 'receptors' column starts 'Ir' (its ORNs' ligand-specific receptor is an IR); the co-receptor columns are beside, not a class

not_dendrite28.rule: E135's lock 'glomeruli' (the 28 that GH146, the pebbled ORN recordings and the model's input share; E90's shared_glomeruli)

few_hemibrain.rule: fewer boutons than the median of the 36 input glomeruli, or fewer claws than their median, in the family's hemibrain wiring (E130 step0_wiring_only('hemibrain-first'), E83's 'real'); the union is the class, each sub-list and their intersection (few_both) beside

bouton_line.source: the thesis's methods (oconnell_thomas_2026.tex: 'PN boutons were imaged in GH146-Gal4/20xUAS-IVS-jGCaMP8m (II)'; '~70% of PNs (labeled by the GH146-Gal4 driver)')
bouton_line.status: unresolved: no published per-glomerulus expression table of GH146-Gal4 on hand that can be named with certainty; the flag is left empty (never inferred from the recordings)
leads: FlyBase FBti0016783: GH146 in ~90 PNs innervating ~40 of ~50 glomeruli (no list)
eLife 2014 (PMC4270039), Figure 1 figure supplement: a per-glomerulus table of GH146-GAL4 and MZ699-GAL4 innervation (an image; not read)

rules.strength: the strength view of kcq/population_fit.py: parts rate and mean (multiples of the panel mean); a part's error is the RMS over odors of (model entry - flies' mean entry) / the part's one-fly unit; the view's error the RMS of its two parts' errors
rules.odor_share: an odor's share of a part's squared error is its squared residual over the part's sum; its share of the view's squared error is (e_rate^2 / n_rate + e_mean^2 / n_mean) / 2 over the view's error^2; the error without an odor's entry removes that odor's term and keeps the number of odors (the planner's lead)
rules.rows: the family's rows are each wiring and the wirings' mean views ('common', whose squared error splits exactly into odor shares); the shares that decide are those of 'common', the mean over wirings of each wiring's share beside
rules.reading: each stage in its default reading (stage_readings.DEFAULT_READINGS); the flies as E134's step 1 reads them (E134 fly_side_read: validation2's KC somata on the largest odor set at least 6 flies share)
rules.halves: E136's seeded split (population_fit.split_halves(n, 1, 0)[0]; the first part 'fit', the rest 'held') of the flies of the all-flies reading, on its odors; the APL16 control half paired with the TNT half of the same name; each half read as the E134 lock's split_halves rule says (curve, noise, reference and one-fly units from the half)

concentrated.rule: a panel's two largest odors carry more than half of the squared strength error on both halves of the flies
concentrated.largest: the two odors with the largest share of the squared view error on all flies, the family as fitted, row 'common'
concentrated.on_halves: their summed share of the view's squared error on each half (each half's own reading, row 'common') above 0.5
beside: each half's own two largest and their share
the family as held, read the same way
concentrated.per: panel and condition (APL16 with APL on and with APL off)

carrying.rule: a panel's odors that carry its error: the family's (as fitted, and as held where read) 2 largest on all flies and any other with at least 0.1 of the squared view error, at most 5 per reading

feeders.rule: an odor's feeders: the smallest set of glomeruli, by descending positive input, carrying 0.6667 of its summed positive input
sources: the model's input on its 36 glomeruli (the panel's input; the class reading)
the panel's ORN recordings, every recorded glomerulus (beside)

d.rule: the male CNS gives those glomeruli more boutons or claws
d.glomeruli: the union of the model-input feeders of the panel's two largest odors (the class 'concentrated' names)
d.reading: on both male calyces the glomeruli's summed share of the calyx's boutons, or of its claws, is above the hemibrain's (shares, since the calyces differ in size)
d.read_on: megamat, as the entry says; every panel beside

not_read: (a) and (b): they need design item 6, held
rules.item6: held for Tom's or Yang's word (the regression fits to a held-out panel); refused by the command line

note: written before any residual (model minus flies) was computed; every part but classes refuses until this file is committed (require_classes_lock)
